blocks.text: We thank you for your enquiry and are pleased to offer our windows and doors as per the enclosed design, specifications and value.

1. Specs & sizes: Opening sizes may differ by 7–9 mm after site measurement.
2. Pricing: Ex-Works, White profile unless noted. GST extra as applicable.
3. Payment: As per agreed schedule. Order confirmation required to start production.
4. Delivery: Typically 3 weeks or more from confirmation, subject to site readiness.
5. Validity: This quotation is valid for 15 days.
6. Warranty: Profile manufacturing defects as per company policy. Glass excluded unless specified.
